name: Midland County, MI
findings: Midland County has 347 nonprofit organizations. 152 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 115 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Midland County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 20 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Midland County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Economic development organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 5 economic development organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 1 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do economic development organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?
